ledger: Aerodynamic slipstream from car motion affecting hair
Aerodynamic slipstream from car motion affecting car antenna

findings.invariant_violated: Air resistance on thin vertical objects during motion
findings.description: The vehicle is in motion (evidenced by moving background scenery and road markings), creating airflow over the roof. While the woman's hair streams back confirming airflow, the thin vertical antenna on the rear roof remains perfectly rigid and upright, showing no deflection or vibration from air resistance.
